composition_subtypes.role: DP to determine reachable total segments after i digits
Greedily pick largest digit ensuring remaining cost feasible

payload.core_composition_summary: DP computes reachable states with exact segment cost; greedy selects max digit ensuring remaining cost feasible.
payload.rationale: Solution first uses 2D DP to check feasibility of turning on exactly k segments across n digits, then greedily constructs the lexicographically maximum number using the DP table.
